notes.subject: זרים / נכר
notes.rationale: Tupela tok Hibru i wankain mining; Tok Pisin i usim wankain tok wantaim tupela

notes.subject: yu olgeta
notes.rationale: Yisrael i save long dispela tok — ol man bilong narapela hap bai i wokim wok bilong ol

translation: Na ol man bilong narapela hap bai i sanap, na ol bai i lukautim ol sipsip na meme bilong yu olgeta; na ol pikinini bilong ol man bilong narapela hap bai i wokim gaden bilong yu olgeta, na ol bai i lukautim ol divai wain bilong yu olgeta.

tokens.gloss: ol sipsip na meme bilong yu olgeta
